title: Four CMIP6 historical runs do not reproduce the 1985-2014 oxygen loss on sigma0 26.5 off southern California; in their ideal-age fields AOU follows age, but the ventilation-only ratio is 0 to 1.4
abstract: Question: do CMIP6 models reproduce the oxygen loss on sigma0 = 26.5 that bottle data show off southern California (CalCOFI) and at Bermuda (BATS), and how does the ventilation-only test of a GLODAP tracer study (observed ratio 0.55) behave in model worlds where the true water age is known? Approach: we read only the needed chunks of the public CMIP6 Zarr stores for GFDL-ESM4, CanESM5, ACCESS-ESM1-5 and IPSL-CM6A-LR (historical and piControl, r1i1p1f1). We put September fields of 16 years (1985-2014) on density surfaces and compared 2005-2014 with 1985-1994 in boxes. Three models give ideal age; for GFDL-ESM4 we calculated CFC-12 and SF6 transit-time ages. Results: off California, observed oxygen fell by 22.3 umol/kg; the models gave -15.0 (GFDL-ESM4), -3.4, -0.1 and +3.9 umol/kg, and piControl segments gave -3.2 to -0.2. At BATS, observations show no loss before 2015 (+2.7), but three models lost 3.6 to 12.0 umol/kg. In 10 of 12 ideal-age model-box cases, AOU followed age after detrending (r = 0.61 to 0.99), but the ratio of the AOU change to the ventilation-only prediction (AOU/age x age change) was 0.26-0.72 in IPSL-CM6A-LR, 0.01-1.39 in ACCESS-ESM1-5 and -2.9 to 0.6 in CanESM5. Thus the observed 0.55 is typical of model worlds where AOU follows age, and the ratio alone cannot separate ventilation from respiration. In GFDL-ESM4, CFC-12 and SF6 ages gave age increases that differ by a factor of 1.4. Limitations: one member per model, one month per sampled year, large mean-state biases, approximate drift control (no IPSL control oxygen), no respiration diagnostic, and runs that end in 2014.

Black: observed bottle series from campaign publications (reference 1985-1994; BATS 1989-1994). Colours: one historical member of each model, September samples. Grey bands: comparison windows.

Left: AOU change (2005-2014 minus 1985-1994) against the ventilation-only prediction OUR_E x d(age) for model boxes (squares; ideal age, or CFC-12 TTD age for GFDL-ESM4) and observed GLODAP section pairs (circles). Right: ratio R with 95% intervals (squares) and kappa = temporal AOU-age slope / OUR_E (open circles); dashed line: observed pooled ratio 0.55. Values clipped to -1 to 2.5.
